programmes.d: When a policeman's wife is murdered, the officer attempts to take the law into his own hands to seek out and execute the killer.

A famous research scientist, duped into believing he shot a man, disappears from his vital government post. Meanwhile, McGarrett's investigation is being hampered by officious help from another arm of the government.
A scientific genius disappears after discovering a biological mutation which is hostile to every form of life on earth.
MacGyver and Pete Thornton are taken hostage by a group of terrorists threatening to take over a nearby city.
MacGyver is shocked when he learns that the thief who stole a vial of deadly bacteria from the Phoenix Foundation is an old friend who once saved his life.
A newly released convict bent on revenge hunts down MacGyver in the woods, using Pete Thornton and Jack Dalton as bait.
When MacGyver Is wounded during an assassination attempt and subsequently framed as the sniper he must rely on the help of an insecure schoolgirl to save his life and foil the true assassin's plan.
MacGyver joins forces with a bounty hunter in the search for a woman who is the target of jewel thieves.
